hypothesis: Placeholder candidate: a deterministic sparse field of ~10,000 dots along six NNE-trending straight corridors with +/-400 m perpendicular jitter. It is generated to be off-lattice and unique, not to be predictive.
mechanism: No feature layer is read. Dots are placed by numpy RNG (seed 24301) on fixed corridor intercepts (linspace 4,480,000 to 4,500,000 m northing, slope tan 60 deg), burned as radius-2 disks. Source: scripts/generate_unique_submission.py.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: None is modelled. Straight corridors would coincide with any linear NNE feature (roads, power lines, aligned drainages) only by chance; no signal is used to choose them.
